title: Opening
body:
<<img, "samples/visual-novel-interrogation/assets/images/office_interior_nophone.png">>
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, secretary, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Secretary>>
You're late. Again.
<<speaker, Detective>>
The city kept me up.
<<speaker, Secretary>>
The city doesn't pay rent. The landlord came by twice.
<<speaker, Detective>>
How much do we have?
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Enough for the phone bill or the light bill. Pick one.
<<speaker, Detective>>
Keep the phone. I can work in the dark.
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Good. Because the phone rang at eight. Vivian Ash.
<<speaker, Detective>>
The Vivian Ash? Hill money?
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Someone stole her gem last night. The Crimson Heart. She wants us on it today.
<<speaker, Detective>>
Why us?
<<speaker, Secretary>>
She asked for someone discreet. I think she meant cheap.
And somebody was in here last night. I picked all this off the floor and the shelves.
<<speaker, Detective>>
I'll take it. Every bit of it.
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Then straighten your tie. Mrs. Ash didn't wait for a call back. She's outside the door.
<<character, hide, secretary>>
<<character, show, vivian, x = 680>>
<<speaker>>
Vivian Ash walks in without knocking.
<<speaker, Detective>>
Tell me about last night, Mrs. Ash. From the start.
<<startTestimony>>

title: Statement1
body:
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, vivian, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Vivian>>
The Crimson Heart sat in its case all day yesterday. I saw it there myself at seven in the evening.

title: Press1
body:
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, vivian, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Detective>>
All day? Nobody took it out?
<<speaker, Vivian>>
Nobody, darling. It never leaves the house.
<<speaker, Detective>>
Then I'd like another look at that pawn ticket.
<<resumeTestimony>>

title: Wrong1
body:
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, vivian, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Vivian>>
Darling, what is that supposed to be?
<<speaker, Detective>>
Wrong one. What I want says where your gem was yesterday morning.
<<resumeTestimony>>

title: Broken1
body:
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, vivian, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Detective>>
A pawn ticket from Kessler Loans. One red stone, pawned by Mrs. V. Ash yesterday at 9:40 in the morning.
Your gem spent yesterday in a pawnshop safe, not in its case.
<<speaker, Vivian>>
That's... somebody used my name.
<<speaker, Detective>>
Somebody with your handwriting.
<<resumeTestimony>>

title: Statement2
body:
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, vivian, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Vivian>>
The thief forced my display case open. The only key never leaves my bedside table.

title: Press2
body:
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, vivian, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Detective>>
The only key? No spare?
<<speaker, Vivian>>
Just the one, darling. Brass, with a little velvet tassel.
<<speaker, Detective>>
Brass with a velvet tassel. I've seen a key like that today.
<<resumeTestimony>>

title: Wrong2
body:
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, vivian, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Vivian>>
Darling, what is that supposed to be?
<<speaker, Detective>>
Wrong one. What I want opens your display case.
<<resumeTestimony>>

title: Broken2
body:
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, vivian, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Detective>>
The only key to your display case. It was in a coat pocket in my office this morning.
Nobody forced anything. The case was opened with its own key.
<<speaker, Vivian>>
I... must have lost it weeks ago.
<<resumeTestimony>>

title: Statement3
body:
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, vivian, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Vivian>>
And before you ask, this isn't about money. I have more than I could ever spend.

title: Press3
body:
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, vivian, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Detective>>
No debts? No bills?
<<speaker, Vivian>>
The Ash family doesn't have debts, darling. We have accounts.
<<speaker, Detective>>
Then let's look at that torn photo of your front door again.
<<resumeTestimony>>

title: Wrong3
body:
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, vivian, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Vivian>>
Darling, what is that supposed to be?
<<speaker, Detective>>
Wrong one. What I want shows your front door.
<<resumeTestimony>>

title: Broken3
body:
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, vivian, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Detective>>
Your front steps, yesterday. And a bank's notice of sale nailed to your door.
The bank is taking your house, Mrs. Ash.
<<speaker, Vivian>>
Every old house has its paperwork, darling.
<<resumeTestimony>>

title: Breakthrough
body:
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, vivian, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Detective>>
Three statements, three lies. You pawned the Crimson Heart yourself and reported it stolen for the insurance.
<<speaker, Vivian>>
Do you know what it costs to keep a house like mine? The insurance would have saved it. Nobody would have been hurt.
<<speaker, Detective>>
The insurance company would disagree. So would the police.
<<speaker>>
The pawn ticket stays on the desk between them.
